about: Lab PR 236 (multi-match): a new ~/.ssh/authorized_keys created under /home by a user's program. NN-L-FIM-002 (a file created in a watched user-writable directory: Medium, recorded) used to win first-match, so the authorized_keys backdoor (NN-L-FIM-004, High, kill) was a Log. Now both match; FIM-004 is primary (High) and its kill runs.
